mxHelper: Helper Functions for 'OpenMx'

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

2026-11-28 05:11:20

Source: vignettes/mxHelper.Rmd
mxHelper.Rmd

Description

Helper functions for OpenMx models in R (Neale et al., 2016; R Core Team, 2026): matrices with labels, bounds, and vectors of free parameters; covariance matrices from the LDL decomposition with a softplus diagonal; starting values for vector autoregressive models; and fitting until the Hessian is positive definite, with diagnostics and bound handling. Each exported function has an internal version without input checks that other projects can copy.

Installation

You can install the development version of mxHelper from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/mxHelper")

Example 

library(package = "mxHelper")
set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- data.frame(
  y1 = stats::rnorm(n = 100),
  y2 = stats::rnorm(n = 100)
)
fit <- MxHelperQuiet(
  expr = MxHelperMuSigma(x = x, extraTries = 2)
)
MxHelperIsGoodFit(x = fit)
#> [1] TRUE
#> attr(,"criterion")
#> [1] "newton"
MxHelperHasPdHessian(x = fit)
#> [1] TRUE
OpenMx::mxEval(expression = sigma, model = fit)
#>            [,1]       [,2]
#> [1,] 1.07362677 0.02915809
#> [2,] 0.02915809 0.80939139
